hint.REGISTERED: Registered under CIS — a 20% deduction applies to the labour part of your pay.
hint.GROSS: HMRC gross payment status — no CIS deduction is taken (0%).
hint.UNREGISTERED: Not registered for CIS — the higher 30% deduction applies to labour.

card.title: CIS status
card.desc: Your HMRC Construction Industry Scheme standing. Declare your status and submit your UTR + NI so our team can verify you — employers see whether you're verified.
card.verified: Verified — HMRC CIS document approved by our team.
card.notDeclared: You haven't declared your CIS status yet. Submit it below — you can't apply for jobs until you do.
card.unverifiedNoDoc: Self-declared — submit your UTR + NI to get verified (employers currently see this as unverified).
card.docPending: Submitted — our team is verifying your CIS details with HMRC.
card.docRejected: Your CIS submission was rejected — please resubmit with correct details.
card.niOptionalHint: Optional. Sole traders should add it to help HMRC match their record; limited companies can leave it blank.
card.niError: Enter a valid NI number, e.g. AB123456C.
card.evidenceHint: Your UTR (and NI number, if you add one) go to our team for HMRC verification. Until approved, employers see your status as unverified.

breakdown.title: CIS deduction
breakdown.managedNote: Managed (V2): the platform withholds this amount and remits it to HMRC on a monthly CIS return.
breakdown.assistNote: Assist (V1): for information only — the employer withholds and remits this amount to HMRC.
breakdown.pdsAfterRelease: Figures above are an estimate. The final PDS is issued once the milestone is released.

pds.title: Payment & Deduction Statement
pds.desc: The CIS figures a contractor must give the subcontractor within 14 days of the tax month end.
pds.footnote: Generated on demand from live figures. In V2 these are also rolled into the monthly CIS300 return.

admin.invalidPeriod: Enter a valid tax year and month (1–12).
admin.modeDesc: The global switch between Assist (display + PDS only, the employer remits) and Managed (the platform withholds and files). Per-employer overrides still win.
admin.modeAssistHint: Assist: the platform computes the deduction and shows the PDS; the employer withholds and remits to HMRC. Zero tax liability for the platform.
admin.modeManagedHint: Managed: the platform withholds at release, holds the cash, and files + (mock-)remits a monthly CIS300 return.
admin.confirmDesc: After checking with HMRC, set a tradesperson's authoritative status + rate. This verifies a self-declaration.
admin.returnsDesc: Aggregate the month's withheld deductions into a CIS300, then submit + remit. Submit/remit are MOCKED — no real HMRC call or bank transfer happens.
admin.noReturns: No returns yet. Build one for a tax month above.
